sections.overview: The Little Scarlet is an African libellulid dragonfly, smaller and narrower than the related Broad Scarlet C. erythraea.
sections.identification: Mature males are bright red; the species is smaller than C. erythraea and has shorter pterostigmas.
sections.habitat: It favors open rocky streams and ponds.
sections.behavior: It often perches on rocks or bare ground.
sections.reproduction: The field guides give no egg or larval details.
sections.ecology: Adults may stray from water outside the breeding period.
sections.conservation: The atlas calls it widespread but tied to flowing waters.
